items.name: narration_hi
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy 'what if' geography Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel, in natural spoken Hindi like a top Indian geography explainer channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who can't believe how cool this story is and can't wait to tell you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright and punchy, loud-ish and lively. Wide, dramatic pitch movement: rise with real wonder on every question, hit every number with genuine amazement ('WOW' energy), build excitement through each line, and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. 'ये पहले ही हो चुका है' gets a playful, knowing, excited lift. 'लेकिन ये अभी सबसे अजीब बात नहीं है' is whispered-excited, leaning in like a secret. 'एक navy!' is said with delighted disbelief. Bolivia's reply is a cheeky, chill little voice-wink. Numbers and English words (eighteen thirty-six, three, forty-eight million, ninety-nine, country and place names, Confederation, coast, navy, lake, beach, capital) are spoken in English, naturally, the way Indian creators mix them. The last line trails off unfinished on 'क्योंकि सच बताऊं...', voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Pace is quick and bouncy with short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy, bored or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy level throughout. Pronounce Titicaca as tee-tee-KAH-kah, Machu Picchu as MAH-choo PEEK-choo, Lima as LEE-mah, Bolivia as boh-LIV-ee-uh.
lines: अगर Peru और Bolivia एक देश बन जाएं?
अजीब लगा? ये पहले ही हो चुका है... eighteen thirty-six में।
पर पड़ोसी घबरा गए... और इसे सिर्फ़ three साल में तोड़ दिया।
तो आज ये देश कैसा होगा?
करीब forty-eight million लोग... और ज़मीन Mexico से भी ज़्यादा।
और Bolivia को आख़िरकार वापस मिलेगा... समंदर।
इसका पूरा coast Chile के पास चला गया... सौ साल से भी पहले।
लेकिन ये अभी सबसे अजीब बात नहीं है।
बिना समंदर वाले Bolivia के पास आज भी है... एक navy!
जो चलती है एक lake पर... Lake Titicaca.
और Peru ने Bolivia को एक beach उधार दिया है... ninety-nine साल के लिए!
फिर capital का झगड़ा। Lima? Bolivia के पास तो पहले से दो हैं!
Bolivia का जवाब? Capital तुम रखो... मुझे बस beach दे दो!
तो... एक देश या दो? क्योंकि सच बताऊं...
